items.detail_en: The students ask about Dom's life story and her views on the SDGs.
items.detail_zh: 學生採訪 Dom 的個人經歷，以及她對 SDGs 的看法。
items.link_label: Students' prep page 學生預習頁

items.detail_en: The students introduce what makes Huatan special, and share a local snack with Dom.
items.detail_zh: 學生向 Dom 介紹花壇特色，並一起品嘗在地點心。

items.detail_en: Dom visits the school's clubs, including the English News Anchor Club led by the school's foreign teacher.
items.detail_zh: Dom 體驗各個社團，包括由校內外師帶領的英語主播社。
items.note_en: The school wrote 15:00–15:15; we are confirming whether it ends at 15:45.
items.note_zh: 學校寫的是 15:00–15:15，正在確認是否到 15:45。

items.detail_en: More club visits, as planned by the school.
items.detail_zh: 依學校規劃，繼續參觀社團。
items.note_en: We have asked whether this period can become a 15-minute principal interview, so that we can leave around 16:10 for our train back to Taipei.
items.note_zh: 已詢問學校：這一節能否改為約 15 分鐘的校長採訪，讓我們 16:10 左右離開、趕火車回台北。

footnote_en: An afternoon of exchange led by the students, arranged by Ms. Hsu (許景茵老師). In the morning, Dom is at Tachu Elementary.
footnote_zh: 由學生主導的下午交流，許景茵老師安排。當天上午 Dom 在大竹國小。
